Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::orderItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingItem: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode),
		orderEntry: OrderEntry = OrderEntry.allInstance()->any(o|o.Item = existingItem),
		isOrderCreated: Boolean = existingItem.oclIsUndefined()
	precondition:
		existingItem.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newEntry: OrderEntry in
		newEntry.oclIsNew() and
		newEntry.Quantity = quantity and
		newEntry.SubAmount = existingItem.Price*quantity and
		currentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(newEntry)
}
